title: Sâu trang trí của Sobi Cloud: 4 tư thế (trườn duỗi, trườn co, bám thân hoa, bị chim bắt)
decisions: Decision 057 (B4): the decorative caterpillar of the Cloud (cloudBird.ts: appears on a growing / ripe flower, wriggles and inches along the stem, the cloud bird flies over and pecks it away; no gameplay) is a 30x16 code-drawn blob today (texture key cloud_fx_pest, no manifest row). This batch gives it real art in four poses the scene logic already has a moment for. No manifest id exists to keep, so four NEW rows (section props, 96x64) are added on delivery: prop_cloud_caterpillar_a / _b (the two frames of the inching loop, swapped by code), _perch (resting on the stem while the bird has not noticed it), _caught (the instant the bird pecks it, before it pops away). Drawn facing RIGHT; the scene flips it at random. Shown at about 45x30 px, so shapes must stay simple and readable. Original design: a plain garden caterpillar in the cloud palette, no resemblance to any existing character.

sheets.name: C
sheets.title: Sâu mây: 4 tư thế
sheets.notes: All four cells are the SAME tiny cute caterpillar drawn at the SAME scale and in the same colours, body in pure side view FACING RIGHT: a chubby body of five or six round segments in soft mint green with a paler cream belly, tiny lilac spots on its back like little clouds, two short curled antennae, one big friendly dark eye with a white highlight, rosy cheek, a tiny smile, six stubby feet. Rounded, chunky, toy-like, very simple shapes that still read when the sprite is only 45 pixels wide. It floats in empty space: no leaf, no stem, no flower, no ground, no cloud, no shadow under it. Cute, never gross or scary. Original design, no resemblance to any character of any other game, film, book or brand.

cells.desc: Crawling, stretched out long and low: the body is almost flat, head reaching forward
Crawling, bunched up: the middle of the body arched up into a high hump like an inchworm, head and tail close together
Resting: the front half raised upright and the back half flat, looking up happily, antennae relaxed
Startled: curled into a loose C shape, eye wide, mouth a small round O, antennae sticking straight up, two tiny surprise lines above the head
